task: Write an article discussing whether teenagers should have part-time jobs. Give two reasons and one example.
studentDraft: The proliferation of extracurricular commitments among contemporary adolescents has engendered considerable discourse regarding the feasibility of part-time employment. Notwithstanding the manifold benefits that remunerative engagements might ostensibly confer, I maintain that the academic ramifications are too significant to disregard. Firstly, the temporal demands of part-time work inevitably detract from study time. Secondly, the cognitive fatigue induced by balancing school and work responsibilities may impair academic performance. For instance, a student working 15 hours weekly at a retail establishment would likely experience diminished concentration during examination periods. Consequently, I advocate for prioritizing scholastic obligations over vocational pursuits during secondary education.
notes: Sophisticated vocabulary and grammar, but task asks for 'two reasons' and 'one example' — only gives reasons and a hypothetical example (not personal/anecdotal). Tests: strong Language ≠ strong Content.
